title: Iron Dropper
description:
The Iron Dropper is an advanced configurable Dropper with 9 slots. In its gui you can change:

- Redstone mode: Pulse (drops one item per redstone pulse) or Repeat Powered (drops an item every 4 ticks while powered, default)

- Pickup delay of items dropped: None, 5 ticks (default) or 20 ticks

- Motion: whether the dropper spits the items out "perfectly straight" (Nice for Superlubricent Ice/Stone) or randomly

- Effects: whether there are any particles/sound effects (None by default)

It drops one item at a time. If the block in front has an inventory, the item is inserted into it instead.
